voice.note: Inferno Bull (Episode 2 companion). ORIGINAL VOICE, OWNED BY THIS PROJECT — designed via ElevenLabs Voice Design (text-to-voice) from the character profile, not a stock voice. voice_id uWE48TmsTuIjyh2ifoNL, name 'Inferno Bull', category 'generated'. Chosen from 3 design previews by measurement, not guesswork: median F0 77.4 Hz vs 111.9 / 128.9 for the other two, darkest timbre (spectral centroid 1060), and 21.8% of energy below 300 Hz vs 9.5% / 11.8% — i.e. the deepest and thickest of the three, per the founder's 'deep and thick and western old school'. OPERATIONAL NOTE: like the custom 'Lil Blunt' voice, a generated voice is owned by ONE workspace — it requires the ELEVENLABS_API key. generate_audio.py already prefers that key over the legacy ELEVENLABS_API_KEY, so this works, but the legacy workspace would return voice_not_found.
